quote: A person, except a police officer in the performance of his or her duty, shall not drive a motorcycle or moped between moving or stationary vehicles occupying adjacent traffic lanes.

activation.condition: A person drives a motorcycle or moped between moving or stationary vehicles in adjacent traffic lanes.

obligation.description: A person, except a police officer in the performance of his or her duty, shall not drive a motorcycle or moped between moving or stationary vehicles occupying adjacent traffic lanes.

exceptions.trigger: A police officer acts in the performance of duty.
exceptions.effect: The stated prohibition does not apply to that officer.
exceptions.source_clause: except a police officer in the performance of his or her duty

timing.description: During the original between-vehicle driving episode.
